from: June book, night 6 (Samuel Hears the Lord)
p1: Young Samuel helped Eli at the Lord’s house. Eli was old, and his eyes could not see well. One night, the lamp still glowed, and Samuel lay down to sleep.
A voice called, “Samuel!” Samuel ran to Eli. “Here I am! You called me.” Eli said, “I did not call. Lie down again.”
It happened again, and then a third time. Then Eli understood. The Lord was calling Samuel!
p2: Eli said, “If He calls, say, ‘Speak, Lord, for Your helper is listening.’” The Lord came and called, “Samuel, Samuel.” Samuel answered, “Speak; for Your helper is listening.” The Lord who called was Jesus.
The Lord can speak to you too, often as a quiet, warm feeling. Tonight, lie very still and listen, just like Samuel.
old: One night, Samuel was sleeping at the temple. Suddenly he heard someone call his name: “Samuel! Samuel!” He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am!”
But Eli said, “I didn’t call you. Go back to bed.” Samuel went back to bed. Again he heard, “Samuel!” He ran to Eli again, but Eli said, “I didn’t call you.”
This happened THREE times! Finally Eli understood: it was Heavenly Father calling Samuel! Eli said, “Next time, say: ‘Speak, Lord, for I am listening.’”
When Samuel heard the voice again, he said, “Speak, Lord, for I am listening.” Heavenly Father gave Samuel an important message. Samuel became a great prophet!
